ctaSampleReport:
Dear colleagues, I am sending you this report concerning your patient seen in consultation.

REASON FOR CONSULTATION
Postoperative follow-up

MEDICAL HISTORY
Mr. X, 68 years old, is seen for a post-operative follow-up consultation. He reports a marked improvement since the operation, with a gradual reduction in pain. He has had no further hematochezia since the operation. He has not taken any painkillers for several days (the early post-operative period was described as difficult).
defaultDescription: DocNote is the AI-powered medical scribe and clinical documentation assistant for doctors, surgeons and hospitals in Switzerland and Europe. Generate consultation notes, discharge letters, operative reports and ward-round notes from voice in seconds. Swiss-hosted, FADP, GDPR, HIPAA and ISO 27001 compliant.
